description: Returns a [paginated](#pagination) mapping of projects that are using security schemes. You can provide either one or multiple security scheme IDs or project IDs to filter by. If you don't provide any, this will return a list of all mappings. Only issue security schemes in the context of classic projects are supported. **[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).
parameters.name: startAt

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: maxResults

parameters.description: The list of security scheme IDs to be filtered out.
parameters.name: issueSecuritySchemeId

parameters.description: The list of project IDs to be filtered out.
parameters.name: projectId

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the search criteria is invalid.If you specify the project ID parameter

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user doesn't have the necessary permission.

summary: Get projects using issue security schemes
